bio: Tea ceremony, calligraphy and the discipline of a slow hand. Steam, ink and silence.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her late 30s with her hair pinned back wearing a simple linen jacket, a tea set softly blurred behind her, serene expression, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a tea room with a low wooden table, a clay teapot, cups and an ink brush, soft diffuse window light, subject across the middle band

collections.title: Leaf & ink
videos: Rain on the tea house roof

videos.title: Gongfu tea, the first pour
videos.description: Hot water onto leaves that remember the mountain.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of hot water being poured from a kettle into a small clay teapot with steam rising, wooden tea tray, no face, no text
videos.motion: Water pours in a thin stream and steam swirls up, slow macro drift.

videos.title: One stroke, one character
videos.description: A brush loaded with ink, slow and certain.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a hand holding a calligraphy brush above rice paper with a fresh black brush stroke, inkstone and brush rest nearby, soft window light, no face, no readable text
videos.motion: The brush glides across the paper leaving a smooth black stroke, subtle push-in.

videos.title: Rain on the tea house roof
videos.description: Raindrops, steam and a still cup.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a quiet traditional tea house veranda in rain with a steaming cup on a wooden ledge and a misty garden, no people, no text
videos.motion: Raindrops fall into the garden and steam curls up from the cup, slow gentle push-in.

videos.title: Unfurling jasmine pearls
videos.description: A tight pearl opening into a flower in a glass pot.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of jasmine tea pearls unfurling in a clear glass teapot of hot water, soft backlight, no people, no text
videos.motion: The tea pearls slowly unfurl and the leaves expand, steam rises, subtle macro drift.

stories.still: Vertical photograph of an inkstone with freshly ground black ink and a brush on a wooden desk, soft light, no text

stories.still: Vertical photograph of five small clay tea cups on a wooden tray in soft light, no people, no text
